name: softube-tape-mix-bus-glue
description: Transparent mix/master-bus tape glue via Softube Tape. Type A (most Hi-Fi/neutral) at 30 IPS (extended top, tight lows), Amount 3 for only ~1-2 dB transient reduction (crest ~ -0.2..-0.5 dB), Crosstalk 50 for cohesion, HF Trim FLAT (nudge BOOST for air). Peak-safe, conservative — the finalize-mix stage, not a limiter.
intended_for: a near-final stereo mix that wants gentle analog cohesion before mastering. Insert in [[finalize-mix]]; hand to [[master-track]] after.
plugin_build: Softube 'Tape.vst3' (renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE — authorized on this rig, re-verify elsewhere). String-enum params → this harness only.
notes: Keep it subtle: Amount 3 is barely-there glue. The official guide is 'drive until the GUI THD meter reads ~1-1.4%' — headless that meter is unreadable, so cap Amount by crest (only ~1-2 dB reduction) + render-ab.
Warmer/fuller master? tape_speed '15 IPS' (fattest LF). More air? high_freq_trim '2.0'..'BOOST'. Crosstalk 50 tightens + improves mono-sum; OFF to keep maximum width.
Tape compresses already — don't stack a heavy comp after. Verify check-clipping (Input pushes true-peak), measure-loudness, render-ab loudness-matched.
